scope.tier: The helper's services() assembles ContainerTierSandboxProvider only when DSH_SSH_SANDBOX is exactly 'container'. The provider extends the upstream LocalSandboxProvider, so it keeps the same service name (ctx.sandbox), Config and confine(argv, policy, signal) signature.
scope.default: Unset or any other value assembles the upstream LocalSandboxProvider unchanged; every sandbox reply is byte-for-byte identical to the upstream helper.
scope.boundary: Under the container tier, workspace-write returns the caller's argv unchanged with enforcement 'partial', which here means the container owns the file boundary; denialSignatures and runnerFailureRules are empty. read-only and every other mode defer to the upstream LocalSandboxProvider, which still refuses with SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE when no runner is usable; danger-full-access is still refused by the helper before confine.
scope.authority: No work, tool, network or deployment authorization is introduced. The deployment that sets DSH_SSH_SANDBOX=container must itself provide the container boundary; the helper does not verify it.
